crypto.description: AES-256-GCM encrypt/decrypt (random nonce) + deterministic key derivation + base64. Uses JCA only; works on Android and JVM.
crypto.name: Encryption Utilities
crypto.usage: generated apps with user-supplied API keys or sensitive local data.

http-rest.android_framework: none (pure JVM; HttpURLConnection available on Android)
http-rest.description: Minimal synchronous HTTP client over HttpURLConnection: GET/POST/DELETE, query building, JSON bodies, timeouts, gzip. TLS always on.
http-rest.name: REST HTTP Client
http-rest.usage: apps calling OpenAI-compatible chat, weather, REST backends.

json.description: Dependency-free JSON object/array model with a strict recursive-descent parser and serializer. Safe under Java 17 and Android (API 21+).
json.name: Minimal JSON Model + Parser
json.usage: included by the Fast Lane scaffold whenever an app needs structured configuration, persistence or API payloads.

media-image.android_framework: partial (core pure JVM; CameraGlue uses android.provider.MediaStore / Intent)
media-image.description: Aspect-ratio math, sample-size computation and image dimension validation. Android glue uses ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE + MediaStore, respecting runtime camera permission.
media-image.name: Image & Camera Helpers

network.android_framework: partial (core pure JVM; NetworkWatcher glue uses android.net.ConnectivityManager)
network.description: Deterministic connectivity state machine (ONLINE/OFFLINE), change listeners and offline-first policy hinting. Android glue adds ConnectivityManager wiring.
network.name: Network Status & Offline Detection
network.usage: offline-first apps and graceful network-failure UX.

notifications.android_framework: partial (core pure JVM; Notifier glue uses android.app.Notification)
notifications.description: Deterministic notification spec model + notification-permission posture constants. Android glue posts real notifications with channels.
notifications.name: Notifications Helper

retry.description: Exponential backoff with jitter, bounded retries, and a deterministic RetryRunner for network/API calls and startup work.
retry.name: Retry & Backoff
retry.usage: automatic error-fix loops and resilient API calls.

settings.android_framework: partial (core pure JVM; PrefsStore glue uses android.content.SharedPreferences)
settings.description: Type-safe key/value settings with getters/setters, change listeners and structured section building. Android glue maps it onto SharedPreferences.
settings.name: Typed Settings + Preferences

storage-file.description: Deterministic file manifest, safe join, and ZIP-based backup/restore using java.util.zip. Pure JVM.
storage-file.name: File Storage & Backup

storage-sqlite.android_framework: partial (core pure JVM; SqliteStore glue uses android.database.sqlite)
storage-sqlite.description: Versioned schema migrations + typed table builder. Pure core is JVM-tested; Android glue (SQLiteOpenHelper) included for API 21+.
storage-sqlite.name: SQLite Storage

text.description: Slugify, title-case, truncate, strip-to-single-space, format bytes/duration.
text.name: Text Utilities

themegen.description: Deterministic color palettes, WCAG-aware contrast utilities and theme-mode resolution. Pure JVM.
themegen.name: Theme & Dark Mode

time.description: Deterministic elapsed-time measurement (stopwatch) and human-readable formatting.
time.name: Time Utilities

validation.description: Required, email, numeric range, length and regex validators with a composable Result.
validation.name: Form Validation
validation.usage: automatic with every generated app (form screens).
